name: Google Vertex
description: This enables the use of Google Vertex Studio for the AI module.
project_description: Google Vertex is an AI provider plugin for the Drupal AI module that lets a site use chat, embeddings and text-translation models from the Google Vertex AI Model Garden (for example Gemini). Gemini models support richer inputs such as images, documents and video (model dependent). The provider authenticates to Google Cloud with a service-account credential JSON stored in a Key entity (via the drupal/key module); at runtime it mints a short-lived OAuth2 bearer token from that service account and calls the regional Vertex AI REST endpoints. Models are added dynamically at the provider settings page by entering a Project ID, Location (region) and Vertex model id, so the provider is not limited to a fixed model list. It requires the ai and key modules plus the google/cloud-ai-platform Composer library.
